Boohoo Replaces Chairman in Board Reshuffle
By Najat Kantouar
Boohoo Group replaced its chairman in a board reshuffle as the U.K. clothing retailer moves into the next phase of its recovery plan.
The company, which trades as Debenhams, said Friday that Tim Morris, who joined the board in 2021, was stepping down as chairman and leaving the board.
He is replaced by Iain McDonald, who previously served on the board from June 2017 to February of this year.
Meanwhile, the group appointed Michael Stewart and Stephen Rothwell as independent nonexecutive directors.
Stewart has more than a decade of experience in investment management and public markets. He is also a member of Chrysalis Investment Partners, which he joined in March 2024, Boohoo said.
Rothwell brings experience in the technology sector, having founded and led an AIM-listed technology business.
"With the substantive elements of the operational turnaround now complete, the board's focus moves to rebuilding equity value in the group," the company said.
